The invitation

Welcome, epic being.

You have been invited to join us this Halloween for a truly transformational gathering we call Beyond the Veil.

On the 31st of October, as the sun goes down and the veil between worlds thins, a gate will open in the hills of Lakeway to an estate that will become our playground.

For centuries, people have gathered at this time of year to mark the turning from harvest to winter and to honor those who came before. Disguises were worn as a way to walk between worlds, to become someone else for one night and pass unrecognized among the spirits.

This year, we're giving you a permission slip to wear a disguise that does the opposite. Create a costume that celebrates the bigness of your expression.

This event is your canvas, and your gifts are the paint. Be bold, be wild, and play BIG!!

Inside the gates, every expression is honored: your movement, your voice, your dance, and your vibration.

As we move beyond the veil, let the friction fall away, let your “try” die, and let your gifts live.

Everything you need to walk between worlds is below: the flow of the night, inspiration for your costume, and how to get your tickets, rideshare, and parking. Read on, and secure your place before the gate closes.

See you on the other side,Michael & Austin Dance Temple

The Flow

  1. 7:00 to 8:00 PM

    The Arrival

    Doors open at 7 and close at 8. Check in and find your people.

  2. 8:00 to 8:30 PM

    The Gathering

    Photos, then everyone gathers outside.

  3. 8:30 PM

    The Crossing

    The opening ceremony, led by Leah Free, sets the agreements for the whole night. Be there for it.

  4. 9:00 PM to sunrise

    The Night

    Music in two rooms, with performances and entertainment running all the way to sunrise. At 2 AM the clocks fall back, and Halloween gives us an extra hour.

  5. Sunrise, about 6:45 AM

    First Light

    For those still dancing, the final set plays as the sun comes up over the hills.

The Costume

Come as who you're becoming.

Wear silver, violet, blue, chrome, pearl, or anything that catches the light. Sheer layers, liquid metal, crystal and holographic film all belong here.

  • Spectral White
  • Lunar Pearl
  • Liquid Silver
  • Slate Eclipse
  • Moonlit Charcoal
  • Alien Pearl
The moodboardLooks for every body, pinned for this year. On Pinterest. Costume picksPieces we'd wear: headpieces, chrome, sheer layers. On Etsy.

Dress in layers you can move in. The night runs from a cool October evening to sunrise, and much of it happens outdoors. Costume shoes may stay on; everyday shoes come off inside the house.

The Details

Alcohol-free
This is a private, alcohol-free event.
No re-entry
Once you're inside, you're inside.
Doors close at 8 PM
Arrive by 8 so you're settled for the 8:30 ceremony.
Getting here
Rideshare or arrange a drop-off. Parking passes are limited and sold at checkout.
No road parking
Cars parked on the road leading in will be towed, and guests who walk in from the road will be turned away.
Come fed and hydrated
Water stations will be throughout the property.
No pets
Please leave pets at home, and treat the property, art and furnishings with care.
Consent
By attending, you agree to honor consent, clear communication and the people around you. Find any member of our team if you need help.
A curated room
This is not an open invitation. Every guest is chosen for the safety, depth and chemistry of the room.

Nominate a Guest
